# msgvault

> msgvault is open source and runs on your hardware. Save email, chats, meetings,
> calendars, and contacts on your own computer or server. Search across accounts,
> look up a person's history, and work from a browser, terminal, or AI assistant.

Every public page has a Markdown companion for machine reading. Use the links
below, or replace a page's trailing slash with `.md`: `/docs/setup/` becomes
`/docs/setup.md`. The documentation index is `/docs/index.md`.

## Product

- [Product overview](https://msgvault.io/index.md): supported sources, contact
  profiles, search, interfaces, and how deletion works
- [How msgvault works](https://msgvault.io/guide.md): sync and import messages,
  manage contacts, search, review deletions, and back up your archive

- [Documentation](https://msgvault.io/docs/index.md): all operating documentation
- [Setup](https://msgvault.io/docs/setup.md): installation and first sync
